backend.server.js: HTTP server bootstrap & database connection runner
backend.app.js: Express configuration, security middlewares, and route registration

backend..env: Environment configuration variables (Mongo URI, JWT, Razorpay, OpenAI)

config/.multer.js: Multer storage configuration for product uploads

models/.User.js: Customer account schema with bcrypt password hashing
models/.Admin.js: Administrator credentials schema with matchPassword method

models/.Cart.js: Customer persistent shopping cart with sub-documents
models/.Order.js: Order snapshot schema with line items and status tracking

controllers/.userAuthController.js: Customer register, login, logout, profile update, change password
controllers/.adminAuthController.js: Admin login, logout, session verification, dashboard info
controllers/.adminProductController.js: Product CRUD with multipart image uploads
controllers/.adminCategoryController.js: Category CRUD with cover image upload
controllers/.adminOrderController.js: Order status transitions and order item inspect
controllers/.adminUserController.js: Customer registry browsing and customer order history
controllers/.productController.js: Public product search, category filtering, details, related items
controllers/.cartController.js: Add to cart, quantity update, stock ceiling checks, remove item
controllers/.paymentController.js: Razorpay order creation & signature verification with inventory deduction
controllers/.orderController.js: User order list, order details, cancellation with stock restoration
controllers/.inventoryController.js: Stock level queries and manual inventory adjustments
controllers/.aiController.js: Context-aware product AI advisor & general store chatbot
controllers/.reviewController.js: Verified review eligibility check, review submission, admin moderation
controllers/.wishlistController.js: Wishlist get, add, and remove operations
controllers/.recentlyViewedController.js: View tracking and recently viewed items retrieval

routes/.adminRoutes.js: Admin authentication, dashboard, CRUD, and fulfillment endpoints
routes/.productRoutes.js: Public product browsing and category query routes
routes/.paymentRoutes.js: Razorpay test mode order creation and verification routes
routes/.orderRoutes.js: Customer order history and cancellation routes
routes/.aiRoutes.js: OpenAI shopping advisor & product Q&A endpoints
routes/.reviewRoutes.js: Product review submission, querying, and deletion routes

backend.uploads/: Local storage directory for uploaded product, category, and profile media

frontend.vite.config.js: Vite dev server and build configuration
frontend.index.html: SPA HTML5 shell with root div

src/.main.jsx: React 19 root mounting point with React.StrictMode

context/.ToastContext.jsx: Global toast notification provider and useToast hook

utils/.formUtils.js: Form input behavior helpers (number scroll prevention)
